issues.body: The prior-round finding was not addressed. The document still contains exact work-box byte counts and microsecond timings, derived percentages and ratios, run-to-run noise estimates, and exact map/vector capacity observations. It also repeats numeric magnitudes in the findings and disposition. Repository policy prohibits hard-coded performance numbers in Markdown and treats work-box timings as non-canonical; caveats such as "NON-CANONICAL" and "advisory" do not make the committed numbers compliant or prevent them from becoming stale.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the numeric results table and all derived hard-coded magnitudes, including percentages, ratios, microseconds, spread estimates, row/term counts used as measured evidence, and exact byte/capacity observations. Retain the qualitative negative conclusion, methodology, reproducible commands, result-equivalence evidence, and a pointer to generated artifacts from the approved benchmark workflow if available.
issues.title: Prohibited hard-coded work-box performance numbers remain

verdict.summary: Round 1's major issue remains materially unchanged. research/numerics-sparsify-measured.md still commits a full table of non-canonical work-box timings, byte counts, percentages, ratios, noise estimates, and derived exact capacity observations, then repeats those magnitudes in the findings and disposition. The repository contract explicitly prohibits hard-coded performance numbers in Markdown and states that work-box timings are non-canonical; labeling them advisory does not cure the violation. The implementation and equivalence tests otherwise appear coherent from the diff, but this policy breach remains blocking.
